_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil has persisted across 97% of recent 12h windows with no structural breaker (ETF flows, stablecoin growth) materializing to justify a directional commitment.
next_move.brains_agree: No — Analyst says HOLD with medium conviction citing missing institutional bid; Narrative implies an imminent bullish reversal from coiling sentiment, creating a signal split the judge resolves by siding with the Analyst's stricter confirmation criteria and the statistical coil base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 40 and stablecoin growth breaks above 55 with funding staying below 45
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding spikes above 65 with price breaking below $60K, or VIX collapses below 45 while DXY strengthens above 55
